scripts.start:prod: npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=../prisma/schema.prisma && node dist/server.js
scripts.check:env: node -e "const required=['DATABASE_URL','JWT_SECRET','JWT_REFRESH_SECRET','FRONTEND_URL']; const missing=required.filter((key)=>!process.env[key]||process.env[key].includes('replace-with-')); if(missing.length){console.error('Missing env vars:',missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1)} else console.log('Environment OK');"
